sources.title: Q-LoRA Fine-tuning | QwenLM/Qwen | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Q-LoRA fine-tuning provides an efficient way to adapt Qwen models to specific tasks with limited computational resources. By using quantized models and low-rank adaptation, it enables fine-tuning of large language models on consumer hardware while maintaining good performance.
